description.value: Yaletown Gelato is a neighbourhood ice cream and gelato shop on Homer Street in Vancouver's Yaletown district. It sits within easy reach of the False Creek Seawall, one of the most popular cycling corridors in the city, making it a natural mid-ride treat stop. The area is dense with street-level retail and is highly accessible by bike.
